verdict.rationale: Paychex documents an OAuth 2.0 REST API with Worker and State Taxes resources. Its use cases include maintaining employee data with Paychex as the source of record and syncing from an external HR system, which suggests an agent could create a worker and set up state taxes. The evidence never confirms that workers can be created through the API, never mentions a compensation or pay-rate setup endpoint, and gives no end-to-end onboarding flow; probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt for agent consumption. Missing for 10: explicit worker-creation endpoint docs, compensation/pay-rate API, federal tax/withholding setup via API, end-to-end onboarding workflow docs, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration.
